script.opening: Morning — is Gary about? ... You don't know me, and I'll be straight with you — this is a cold call. Thirty seconds, and if it's no use I'll go away.
script.hook: I had a look at plumbers' merchants in the Streatham area, and yours came up well — decent reviews, no website. I won't take much of your time.
script.valueStatement: What I normally do is a small, one-off site — what you stock, your hours, your reviews on it. That's about the size of it.
script.demoOffer: I wouldn't want to put anything together without knowing it's the right time for you first — is this something that would even be useful at the moment?
script.pricing: It's four hundred pounds, once, if it's ever the right time — but I get the sense that's a bigger question than the website itself.

discovery.question: How are things going for the business at the moment generally?
